name: Lydia Design Studio
old_description: We are a leading clothing production company based in Atlanta, GA, offering top-quality clothing and supporting the domestic apparel manufacturing industry in the USA.
about:
Lydia Design Studio operates from Atlanta, Georgia, where head designer Lydia founded the company to provide domestic apparel manufacturing services. The studio positions itself as a boutique operation offering personalized attention from concept through finished goods.

The company delivers end-to-end cut-and-sew production entirely in-house. Its workflow covers design consultation, hand sketching, pattern-making, sample development, fabric cutting, sewing, printing, finishing, and a three-stage inspection process at pre-cut, mid-sew, and post-finish stages. Product categories include t-shirts, leggings, jeans, hoodies, jackets, underwear, and sweatshirts, all customizable with custom labels, tags, and packaging.

Clients range from startup fashion brands to established clothing companies and film studios seeking made-in-USA garments. The studio emphasizes low minimum order quantities to accommodate emerging labels while also serving larger production runs.

Lydia Design Studio differentiates itself through boutique-level care, competitive pricing relative to New York and Los Angeles manufacturers, a commitment to eco-friendly and sustainable materials, and fast turnaround times. The founder, Lydia, personally oversees each project to ensure quality and alignment with the client's vision.
